findings: V2 pilot cache producer binds the immutable campaign projection copy, its exact SHA256 and the declared D/2 family row. It does not read the source-tree projection while auditing endpoints.

Shared tensor/load/cache/reset implementation now accepts an explicit projection and checker; the public v1 default still uses its source projection. No old storage policy, closed controller or scientific selection rule changed.

An exclusive bounded audit-attempt document precedes expensive work and binds slot/request/result/projection/tokenizer/training-input/cache-contract identities. Successful report and failure diagnostics use the bounded metadata writer. Existing attempt/failure/partial/success evidence prevents retry.

Full stage review requires the v2 producer kind, matching attempt reference/hash/content and the frozen campaign projection binding. Failure and partial audit files reject a stage even if included in its evidence manifest.

Synthetic tests exercised serial raw/H200 checkpoint loads with model release, exact projection use, projection/attempt mutation, STOP, runtime/fallback/token failures, publication failure and preserved attempts. Public default cache tests remain passing.
limitations: No actual MPS cache measurement or wide-model numerical optimizer/resume/EMA test was run. Tests used tiny checkpoints with mocked model/MPS/cache APIs; they cannot justify quality, performance or feasibility claims.

The caller must enforce the complete frozen campaign identity, all9 numerical prerequisites, training input provenance, full remaining storage, inherited worker locks and600s/4GiB/6GiB/8GiB resource profile. This module is not a worker launcher.

Checkpoint tensors, corpus, projection and exact training-token identities are rechecked by the shared reviewer. Resource completion must still bind the produced audit hash, and all three completed pilot audits must pass the separate stage review.

Actual v2 training/export sink integration, pilot worker, complete controller/stage/cleanup-chain/inference acceptance and real numerical/input/measured-pilot prerequisites remain outstanding. No research checkpoint deletion, plan freeze, failed-fixture retry or closed-campaign rerun occurred.
